name: vscode-frontier-insight
description: Run autonomous research quests inside VSCode, powered by your Copilot subscription via the sanctioned vscode.lm Language Model API. Local Python engine drives an 11-node async LangGraph DAG; this extension hosts the LLM calls.

chatParticipants.name: fi
chatParticipants.description: Run a research quest through the FI engine.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Interactive setup — walks you through topic, outputs, clarify mode, reviewer panel; generates a config.yaml and runs it. Recommended for first-time users.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start a quest from an existing YAML. Example: @fi /start examples/integrator_bakeoff/config.yaml

commands.name: fleet
commands.description: Start a fleet of quests (space-separated YAML paths). Each YAML's provider.node_models is honored independently.

frontierInsight.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for the FI engine. Must have FI's requirements.txt installed.

frontierInsight.repoPath.description: Absolute path to the FrontierInsight repo (containing launch.py). Defaults to the open workspace root.

frontierInsight.outputDir.description: Where finished quests are written (relative to repoPath or absolute).
